name: BudsLink
blurb: BudsLink provides comprehensive battery monitoring and feature control for supported Bluetooth wearable audio devices, including popular models from Apple, Beats, Sony, Samsung, Go
description:
BudsLink provides comprehensive battery monitoring and feature control for supported Bluetooth wearable audio devices, including popular models from Apple, Beats, Sony, Samsung, Google, and Nothing. The application communicates directly with supported devices to expose battery levels, noise control modes, and advanced interaction features when available, offering a consistent and configurable interface across different vendors.

This application is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Apple, Sony, Samsung, Google, Nothing, Bose, Redmi, Xiaomi or Sennheiser.

• Monitor earbud and charging case battery levels

• Control Active Noise Cancellation and ambient sound modes

• Support conversation awareness on compatible devices

• Automatic volume reduction during conversation awareness

• Media pause and resume using in-ear detection

• Device-specific configuration for gestures and controls

• Customizable device icons and appearance settings

• Optional overrides for system dark mode and accent colors

Supported Bluetooth audio wearables

• Airpods / Beats

• Sony

• Samsung Galaxy Buds

• Google Pixel Buds

• Nothing / CMF

• Bose

• Redmi / Xiaomi

• Sennheiser
